name: Eterna
source: Eterna Plc audited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (PricewaterhouseCoopers report dated 3 April 2026): consolidated statement of profit or loss, group column. Revenue 302,369,941 and cost of sales 286,885,505 in N thousands, stored in absolute naira; FY2024 comparative from the same statement. Operating expenses are selling and distribution 156,851 plus general and administrative 12,766,498. Operating profit 12,575,724 is the printed line and reconciles from gross profit less operating expenses plus other income 9,434,197 less impairment 18,695 plus net foreign exchange gain 599,135. Net finance costs are finance cost 5,319,965 less finance income 17,792. EPS is the printed basic figure in naira (2.24; 1.03) on 1,302,073,000 shares. Profit before tax less income tax ties to profit after tax in both years. Read 25 October 2026. | CRON 20261108: FY2023 and FY2022 columns added from the Deloitte-audited consolidated statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income, page 4 of the Eterna Plc Annual Report and Consolidated Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2023 (NGX filing library), group column, N thousands scaled to absolute naira. FY2023: revenue 183,282,139; cost of sales 166,420,202; gross profit 16,861,937; selling and distribution 404,331 plus general and administrative 8,726,596 gives operating expenses 9,130,927; other income 61,484; operating profit 7,792,494; net foreign exchange loss 18,403,951; finance income 39,669; impairment reversal 108,987; finance cost 1,511,546; loss before tax 11,974,347; taxation was a credit of 2,541,235 stored as a negative income tax so that loss before tax less income tax equals the printed loss 9,433,112; basic and diluted EPS 7.23 naira loss. FY2022: revenue 116,472,441; cost of sales 107,475,193; gross profit 8,997,248; selling and distribution 283,021 plus general and administrative 5,739,135; other income 232,417; operating profit 3,207,509; net foreign exchange loss 159,744; finance income 41,047; impairment charge 300,671; finance cost 690,267; profit before tax 2,097,874; taxation 1,085,622; profit 1,012,252; EPS 0.78 naira. Identities tie in both years. FY2023 ROE is withheld because audited total equity of 3,501,848 thousand against a 9,433,112 thousand loss produces a ratio beyond the plausibility ceiling used across this dataset; the other ratios use the printed total assets 59,640,303 (2023) and 54,216,098 (2022), total liabilities 56,138,455 and 41,085,514, and total equity 13,130,584 for 2022.
